frozen_law: One semantic V554 proposition/use/rule may not count equivalent direct plus V553 support twice.
Direct StructuralEmpiricalAdmission to V554 is lawful only for the exact temporally-complete positively rule-eligible target use.
A target use requiring new V553-owned temporal/comparability meaning cannot be satisfied by direct fallback.
V553 cannot manufacture source-universe equivalence, pooling, sample linkage, estimand compatibility, or composition authority.
Applicable explicit denial and hard temporal negative authority precede positive F1 emission.
Observed numeric zero is measurement, not missing authority.
VALID_EMPTY, DENIED, NONCOMPARABLE, MISSING_AUTHORITY, UNKNOWN_OR_CONFLICTING_AUTHORITY, observed zero, and zero-support remain distinct.
No latest, score, readiness, recency, majority, specificity, filename, row order, artifact-presence, or convenience tie-break is authorized.
Provenance reachability is not source composition authority.
hostile_finding: A single flat dedup hash cannot safely represent semantic support identity, authority version identity, basis path identity, and provenance lineage simultaneously.

authority_snapshot_fingerprint.purpose: preserve exact authority version/hash and decide compatibility, supersession, or conflict without creating extra semantic support

basis_provenance_fingerprint.purpose: retain physical basis path, producer refs, lineage roles, and replay identity without multiplying support

lineage_role_law.PROVENANCE_ONLY: exclude from SUPPORT_EQUIVALENCE_KEY but retain in provenance fingerprint
lineage_role_law.IDENTITY_BEARING: include exact governed lineage refs in SUPPORT_EQUIVALENCE_KEY

authority_version_law.same_support_explicit_governed_compatibl: obey exact relation and retain historical snapshot provenance
authority_version_law.forbidden: do not use semver ordering, latest commit, mtime, filename, row order, score, readiness, or majority

direct_v553_law.no_added_v553_meaning: if direct admission is complete for the exact invocation and V553 temporal_effect_for_target_use is NONE with identical temporal semantics, direct is canonical semantic carrier and V553 is duplicate provenance only
direct_v553_law.new_v553_meaning_required: only matching V553 semantic basis may satisfy the invocation; direct is ineligible for that invocation
direct_v553_law.v553_hard_negative: NONCOMPARABLE or required ABSENT/GAPPED temporal authority blocks positive F1; no direct or weaker-signature fallback

epistemic_state_law.observed_numeric_zero: measurement; may remain positive if all authority requirements pass
epistemic_state_law.zero_support: producer-owned support state; not equivalent to observed zero
epistemic_state_law.positive_assertion_of_absence: producer-owned semantic assertion; not inferred from zero or missing
epistemic_state_law.denied: hard target-use block when applicability is exact
epistemic_state_law.noncomparable: hard temporal block for affected relational invocation
epistemic_state_law.valid_empty: coherent zero-candidate run; creates no candidate support key

downstream_handoff.M2: Canonical V554 F1/B1 identity must be assigned after the dedup/authority court; duplicate provenance must not multiply the exactly-one-F1 route input to V555.
downstream_handoff.M3: No new V556 authority is proposed; source/provenance distinctions must remain exact through V555 so later V556 cannot infer composition from provenance or collapsed source identity.
